description: SingleCare prescription coupon prices for a drug: price at each nearby pharmacy (Kroger, CVS, Walgreens, Walmart...) with loyalty price and distance, the lowest price, form, strength and quantity priced, usual retail cash price, generic/brand flag and monthly price history. From singlecare.com's public drug pages via a residential proxy; the pharmacy list depends on the ZIP. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

drug.description: Drug name as in singlecare.com/prescription/<name>, e.g. lipitor, atorvastatin-calcium, amoxicillin

zip.description: Optional 5-digit US ZIP code for nearby pharmacies
